class.name: isaac_ros_deploy_ros2_control/TopicBasedSystemInterface
class.description: Hardware system interface that communicates with Isaac Sim over ROS 2 topics. Subscribes to sensor_msgs/JointState for joint state feedback and sensor_msgs/Imu for IMU data. Publishes sensor_msgs/JointState with per-joint position and velocity targets to Isaac Sim, where the actuator pipeline (Newton via the isaacsim.core.experimental.actuators extension) runs PD / PID / clamping / delay inside the simulator at physics rate.

class.name: isaac_ros_deploy_ros2_control/TopicSensorInterface
class.description: Hardware interface that subscribes to a Float64 topic and exposes it as a state interface. Useful for receiving scalar inputs from ROS topics.
